title: Support of an integer multiplicity current equals the support of its weight (Simon 6.2.12 with 6.3.2(3))
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) a current (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (IMRep U n: M ⊆ U Borel, countably n-rectifiable, θ ≥ 1 on M integer valued and locally H^n-integrable in U, ξ an H^n-measurable unit orientation of the approximate tangent planes H^n-a.e. on M) with T = τ(M, θ, ξ), i.e. T(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). Let μ = θH^n⌞M (R.measure). Then spt T = U ∩ spt μ, where spt μ is the set of points all of whose neighbourhoods have positive μ-measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support
